title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!
altTitles: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. Kan
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax
synopsis: As the members of the Service Club band together to host a school prom, Hachiman, Yukino and Yui will have to put their feelings into words and truly learn to understand each other at long last… if the Service Club can even stay afloat, that is!
